accessibility.evidence: Named progress elements, decorative artwork hidden from assistive technology, status/error announcements, disabled pending check-in, keyboard detail open and post-equip focus return verified by achievement-unlocks.browser.mjs. Existing loadout keyboard and dialog regressions pass.

responsive.evidence: 375/768/1440 width assertions pass after responsive layout settles. Inspected all three captures and English mobile: wrapped copy, two-column tablet/desktop, one-column mobile, no clipped text. Native progress colors use the existing primary token.

loading.evidence: loading.png and delayed-RPC browser scenario show loading copy and a disabled check-in without invented progress.

empty.evidence: The failure/retry scenario starts with authenticated zero progress; after a successful check-in it shows one day. Account-switch test confirms all-zero progress of the second account, while guest views omit progress entirely.

error.evidence: error.png and checkin-error.png distinguish failed reads from failed attendance writes. Both recovery paths pass without false grants.

partial.evidence: partial-loadout.png: wallet and existing free catalog remain usable when unlock lookup fails; achievement rewards remain locked.

success.evidence: unlocked.png shows the 30th-day reward notice and completed button. Profile and seven-day board equip survive reload and broken attendance streak. Double-click submits one mutation.

permission.evidence: guest captures offer login without false counters. locked-dialog.png exposes the condition without an equip action. SQL and socket tests independently reject forged equip requests. Delayed read and check-in responses from the old account cannot affect the new account.

renderedEvidence.observation: Attendance button, current streak, next profile reward and four collection cards fit the single-column layout.
Two-column collection keeps the reward portrait, condition and progress aligned without crowding.
Desktop hierarchy follows the existing rank-page heading and warm palette; permanent unlocks and unfinished goals are distinguishable.
